measurement: Sizes describe the visible drawing, including its vessel or handle, at alpha > 16. Preserve its natural aspect ratio; transparent canvas padding does not count toward its intended extent.
basis: stories/cookbook/design-brief.md#visual-identity and projects/cookbook-study/cookbook/production/catalogue/catalogue.json. New subjects use the established 4px/cm yardstick and comparable originals. Compound fitted servings and fixed stations have separate registration.

mushrooms.reason: Loose ingredient cluster, larger than the 60px apple sample.

chopped-mushrooms.reason: Preparation dish; matches the 100px filling bowls.

mushroom-filling.reason: Matches the original 100px root-and-yogurt filling bowl.

buttered-noodles.reason: Matches the original 112px cooked noodle plates.

ravioli-with-brown-butter.reason: Matches the original 112px finished ravioli plate.

beef-fillet.reason: Approximately 30cm whole fillet at the established 4px/cm yardstick.

mushroom-coated-beef.reason: Whole fillet with its mushroom coating.

unbaked-wellington.reason: Coated fillet with an additional pastry envelope.

beef-wellington.reason: Whole roast, cut slice and serving platter; comparable to the original 160px complete supper plate.

brown-butter.reason: Small saucepan plus long handle, within the established 120–176px utensil range.

brown-butter-with-herbs.reason: Same saucepan and scale as plain brown butter.

sweetened-brown-butter.reason: Mixing bowl and spoon; matches the 112px batter bowls.

biscuit-dough.reason: Matches the original 88px scone and soda bread dough portions.

cup-of-boiling-water.reason: Matches the original 84px hot chocolate cup.

cup-of-tea.reason: Same cup and scale as the boiling water.

apple-juice.reason: Juice jug body matches the water carafe physical scale; the independently sized cut apple matches the roughly35px fruit bodies in Apples.

jar-opener.reason: Includes a demonstration jar as well as the handled tool; keeps the jar near the existing preserving-jar scale.

white-roux.reason: Handled saucepan; same scale through all sauce stages.

sliced-cucumber.reason: Small loose ingredient portion; uses the standalone minimum.

cucumber-finger-sandwiches.reason: Small serving plate, comparable to the original 112px pasta and other finished-dish plates.

chefs-knife.reason: Matches the original 152px bread knife's long-tool scale.
